paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, type knocked out of black panels

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, bold panels, the dominant non-white surface — carries a barely-perceptible cool tint that softens it from pure #000

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Button strokes, logo fill, and the heaviest typographic moments where absolute zero contrast is required

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Dividers, card borders, image outlines, table rules — the only mid-tone in the system

whyte.$description: Single-weight type system. 95px display headlines for the wordmark and section titles carry the brand's editorial weight; 18–20px reads as body and meta; 16px as captions and link lists. The single weight (400) at all sizes is a signature choice — no bold, no light, the hierarchy is built through SIZE, not stroke. Substitute with Inter, Söhne, or Neue Haas Grotesk.

apple-system.$description: System fallback for environments where Whyte is unavailable; inherits macOS/iOS native rhythm. Use only as the last-resort stack, not the primary voice.
